template: hump(multiply(trade_when(greater(ts_rank(ts_delta(ts_regression(winsorize(ts_delta(ts_backfill({reported_asset_value}, 20), 20), std=4), group_mean(winsorize(ts_delta(ts_backfill({reported_asset_value}, 20), 20), std=4), log(ts_mean(cap,21)), sector), 126, rettype=0), 5), 60), 0.9), ts_delta(ts_regression(winsorize(ts_delta(ts_backfill({reported_asset_value}, 20), 20), std=4), group_mean(winsorize(ts_delta(ts_backfill({reported_asset_value}, 20), 20), std=4), log(ts_mean(cap,21)), sector), 126, rettype=0), 5), 0), divide(1, add(1, ts_std_dev(ts_regression(winsorize(ts_delta(ts_backfill({reported_asset_value}, 20), 20), std=4), group_mean(winsorize(ts_delta(ts_backfill({reported_asset_value}, 20), 20), std=4), log(ts_mean(cap,21)), sector), 126, rettype=0), 20)))), filter=true), 0.02)
idea: 特质性流动加速度与波动率调整 —— 提取126日特质性残差后计算5日变化率（加速度），仅当加速度处于过去60日前10%分位（资金流入显著加速）时触发信号，同时以残差自身20日波动率的倒数作为置信权重（低波动高置信），并通过hump函数控制最小调仓阈值以降低换手率。
